messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: page: kv-cache-pressure-high - us-west-2 streaming endpoints p99 spike > 1200ms. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/api/alerts/9283 :rotating_light:
Aisha (oncall): I'm on it. any impact on customers? which pools?
Jin (sre): Seeing p95 ~ 240ms, p99 ~ 1.3s for streaming/v1/generate in us-west-2. Error rates steady, just latency. Prefill eviction rate up 4x last 15m.
Priya (runtime): KV prefill queues are ballooning. Prefill queued=1187, decode backlog=210. Prefill vs decode imbalance: prefill threads can't keep up with rapid short-prefetch churn.
Marcus (infra): Disk-backed paging fired on shard kv-14, slab shrink events at 03:12 UTC. Evictions per-min: 580 -> 2400.
Aisha (oncall): Can we get a quick log snippet for the prefill pipeline?
Jin (sre): paste logs:
```
[03:11:22 UTC] prefill: queue_size=1187, workers=8, avg_latency=120ms
[03:11:23 UTC] decode: in_flight=210, avg_decode_ms=26
[03:11:24 UTC] eviction: slab=kv-14, evicted_pages=120, reason=fragmentation
[03:12:05 UTC] streaming: tail_latency_p99=1320ms, p95=235ms
```
Priya (runtime): Root cause looks like sudden burst of short-context queries hitting many shards causing fragmentation. Prefill generates small KV writes across slabs -> many small free blocks -> slab allocator thrashes and triggers paging.
Aisha (oncall): Live mitigation proposals: 1) temporarily cap prefill concurrency, 2) increase decode concurrency, 3) route heavy streaming traffic to us-east-1. Which is fastest?
Marcus (infra): Fastest is cap prefill concurrency and bump decode workers. We can flip a flag: `rwdctl runtime set prefill_rate=0.5 --cluster us-west-2` and `rwdctl scale runtime decode-workers +4 --cluster us-west-2`.
Priya (runtime): I'm applying prefill_rate throttle now.
ops-bot: Executing: `rwdctl runtime set prefill_rate=0.5 --cluster us-west-2` -> success
Priya (runtime): Increasing decode workers by 4 (rolling across nodes), will take ~90s.
Marcus (infra): Also enabling temporary slab-coalescing patch on kv-14: `kvtool coalesce --shard kv-14 --aggressive` (non-disruptive). Doing that now.
Jin (sre): Noted customer impact: three enterprise customers show SLO violations on p99 within window 03:05-03:20 UTC. CS notified (cc @carla-scs).
Aisha (oncall): @Tom (oncall-next) FYI, handing off after we stabilize. Tom acknowledged?
Tom (oncall-next): here, will join if needed. timeline?
Priya (runtime): 45s after actions started p99 dropped to ~520ms. Logs:
```
[03:13:10 UTC] prefill: queue_size=420, workers=8
[03:13:12 UTC] decode: in_flight=280, avg_decode_ms=24
[03:13:30 UTC] streaming: p99=510ms, p95=140ms
```
Aisha (oncall): Nice. Keep the prefill_rate=0.5 for now, monitor for 30m. Marcus, any risk from slab coalesce?
Marcus (infra): Low risk, coalesce is safe; it reduces fragmentation but increases short-term CPU on shard. CPU spike +12% for ~2m. Watching.
Jin (sre): Adding an alert rule tweak: raise prefill-eviction alert threshold by 1min to avoid noisy flips since we have manual throttle in place.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-9283745000. Severity: high. Impact: SLO breaches for streaming p99. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-9283745000
Aisha (oncall): CS update: Carla, please add impacted customers list and the exact windows. We'll include mitigation steps and ETA for follow-up.
carla-scs: Will do, pinging customers now and collecting logs. Template note: we are transparently reporting latency spike, mitigation actions: prefill throttle, decode scale, slab coalesce. ETA for follow-up 2 hours.
Priya (runtime): Observability: adding histogram of prefill queue length to the dashboard and recording before/after for postmortem.
Tom (oncall-next): If things look stable in 15m I can take next shift. otherwise I'll jump in.
Aisha (oncall): TL;DR: p99 spike due to KV fragmentation from prefill churn -> cap prefill and scale decode -> slab coalesce -> p99 improved from ~1.3s -> ~0.5s. Action items: 
- keep prefill_rate=0.5 for 30m (Priya)
- monitor eviction & paging (Jin)
- CS customer notifications & follow-up (carla-scs)
- postmortem + triggers to auto-throttle prefill in future (owner: Priya)
I'll update INC-9283745000 timeline and handoff to Tom at 03:20 UTC. :white_check_mark:
Tom (oncall-next): acknowledged, taking over at 03:20 UTC. Good job team.
